title: Primary Open Angle Glaucoma

steps.tx: **Primary open angle glaucoma** is chronic bilateral optic neuropathy with open angle, raised or statistically normal pressure and no secondary cause, insidiously asymptomatic until advanced field loss. Risk rises with age, family history, myopia, thin cornea and African ancestry in epidemiology teaching. Screening therefore targets disc and field in risk groups rather than pressure alone in populations.
steps.say: Chronic open angle neuropathy together gives silent field loss until advanced stages in adults characteristically over years. Risk groups give screening targeting additionally. Pressure alone gives insufficient detection.

steps.tx: Medical therapy first line in most primary open angle, laser trabeculoplasty increasingly initial where available, surgery for progression or intolerance by target logic.
